title: AfricaNFT
tagline: Africa Focus NFT Marketplace. A platform to showcase African arts and artists
description: This project is to sell and showcase  African art to the world and with NFT, we at AfricaNFT are building a Decentralized marketplace where artists can list and sell their artwork to the world, we saw a problem in Africa, where this continent has a lot of talented artists, but have no place of where to sell or showcase their artwork. so we built a Decentralized NFT marketplace for an African artists to sell and showcase their art to the world.
how_its_made: This project was built with some tools and frameworks like Next.js, we have hardhat, polygon, openzappeline, rariable, skynet . all this allow us as a team to build this project and we wish to continue this project where we are going to have a DAO , allowing member to make decision on how the marketplace runs. .
